item.title: AHICE South East Asia set for record crowd as stellar global speaker line-up grows
item.description: The fourth annual Asia Hotel Industry Conference and Exhibition South East Asia edition (AHICE South East Asia) is shaping up to be held in front of a record crowd, with over 600 delegates including 150 speakers from across the globe set to attend the event at Pan Pacific Singapore on March 10-11, 2026. The post AHICE South East Asia set for record crowd as stellar global speaker line-up grows appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Hilton records full-year net unit growth of over six per cent on back of global demand
item.description: Hilton has reported another phenomenal year of growth, with the company adding nearly 800 hotels and 100,000 new rooms to its global portfolio in 2025, representing full-year net unit growth of 6.7%. The post Hilton records full-year net unit growth of over six per cent on back of global demand appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Marriott’s CEO Capuano says 2025 was a ‘defining’ year for the global chain
item.description: Marriott International President and CEO, Anthony Capuano, says 2025 was a monumental year for the company on the back of solid global growth. The post Marriott’s CEO Capuano says 2025 was a ‘defining’ year for the global chain appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: World’s first Ritz-Carlton Lodge to open on Emirates Wolgan Valley site
item.description: Two travel giants, Emirates and Marriott International, have come together to open Emirates Wolgan Valley, a Ritz-Carlton Lodge in mid-2026. The post World’s first Ritz-Carlton Lodge to open on Emirates Wolgan Valley site appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Virgin Australia to launch flights from Canberra to Denpasar, Bali
item.description: Virgin Australia is set to become the nation’s only carrier to operate international flights from Canberra with the launch of direct flights to Bali, Indonesia on June 22, 2026. The post Virgin Australia to launch flights from Canberra to Denpasar, Bali appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Hyatt records best growth in five years on back of strong signings in Asia Pacific
item.description: Hyatt Hotels Corporation has revealed the company has a new record pipeline of approximately 148,000 rooms as of year-end 2025, driven by strong and sustained development interest across Hyatt’s five distinct brand portfolios. The post Hyatt records best growth in five years on back of strong signings in Asia Pacific appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: BWH Hotels enters 2026 with solid growth momentum globally
item.description: BWH Hotels is entering 2026 with Powerful Growth and Momentum thanks to strategic expansion across brand segments that has fuelled a balanced, high-performing portfolio, according to the company’s President and CEO, Larry Cuculic. The post BWH Hotels enters 2026 with solid growth momentum globally appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: More brands, travel growth fuels Global Hotel Alliance performance in 2025
item.description: The Global Hotel Alliance (GHA), the world’s largest alliance of independent hotel brands, delivered solid full-year 2025 financial results on the back of the company’s continued expansion of its brand network, increased member engagement and rising demand across key markets, especially for international leisure travel. The post More brands, travel growth fuels Global Hotel Alliance performance in 2025 appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: Mina Li to lead Hyatt in Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific Islands
item.description: HM can exclusively reveal Hyatt Hotels has appointed Mina Li as Regional Vice President and Country Manager for Hyatt Australia, New Zealand, and the Pacific Islands. item.title: Exclusive: Sonesta Los Angeles Airport ups the culinary ante at LAX
item.description: The Sonesta Los Angeles Airport hotel recently completed a US$42 million transformation, making it a leading property at LAX for a layover for business and leisure travellers at the bustling hub, headlined by remodelled rooms and some fantastic food and beverage offerings.
